items.name: macOS menu alternates, mixed state, icons, hidden items and open/close events

steps.instruction: Look at the Menu Audit screen in menus-audit.
steps.expect: The status reads Menu ready and the event list is empty.

steps.instruction: In the Kitchen Sink, open Menus > Menu audit, then open the Menu Audit menu in the menu bar. In-process captures do not include menus, so there is no screenshot.
steps.expect: Mixed selection shows a dash, not a checkmark. Starred sample shows a filled star. Hidden sample is absent.

items.name: IME candidate window tracks the caret
items.intent: A person confirms the candidate window sits under the caret.

steps.instruction: Type "nihongo" with the Japanese Romaji input source.
steps.expect: The candidate window sits directly under the caret and overlaps no text.
